entities.summary: Ukraine – Forward! is a social democratic political party in Ukraine. The party has, according to official figures, about 86,000 party members. The official name of the party is: Party of Natalia Korolevska "Ukraine – Forward!". is a political party in Kyiv, established in 1998. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
